verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents a CLI reference, a headless `exec` mode and llms.txt indexes, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. A static CLI reference page and agent-readable llms.txt files are adjacent documentation, not an interactive, runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
